newsitem.title: USA: WesterFed Financial to buyback common stock.
newsitem.headline: WesterFed Financial to buyback common stock.

text.p: WesterFed Financial Corp said Friday its board approved a plan to repurchase up to five percent of its outstanding shares of common stock.
The company said it will buy the shares in the open market during a twelve month period, depending upon market conditions.
The company will conduct the program through certain registered broker-dealers, with repurchases to be made from time-to-time at market prices.
The company will hold the repurchased shares as treasury stock, which can be used in the future for general corporate purposes as needed.
At June 30, there were 5,564,904 shares of common stock outstanding.
WesterFed is the holding company for Western Federal Savings Bank of Montana.
